styles.icon: Minimalist flat vector UI icon. Clean geometric shapes with rounded corners and one uniform stroke width. Single solid color #3A3A40 (dark graphite) only: no other colors, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no outlines of a different color. No text, no letters, no numbers. The icon is centered and occupies about 70% of the canvas. Perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole image, with nothing else on it. Square 1:1.
styles.upgrade: Minimalist flat vector icon for an upgrade card in a mobile puzzle game. Clean geometric shapes with rounded corners and one uniform stroke width. Exactly two colors: dark graphite #3A3A40 for the main shape and the accent color named below for one highlighted part. No gradients, no shadows, no texture. No text, no letters, no numbers. The icon is centered and occupies about 70% of the canvas. Perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole image, with nothing else on it. Square 1:1.
styles.app_icon: Mobile game app icon. Low-poly 3D isometric diorama of a small futuristic city standing on one square floating block of land, viewed from a classic isometric angle. Flat-shaded faceted geometry: every face is one solid flat color, soft light from the upper left. No gradients, no textures, no reflections, no bloom, no outlines. Few large simple shapes, readable at very small sizes. Plain light grey background. The diorama is centered and occupies about 75% of the canvas. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo. Square 1:1, 1024x1024.
styles.banner: Wide promotional banner for a mobile puzzle game about building roads in a growing city. Minimalist flat vector illustration, top-down view, simple geometric shapes. Soft pastel palette: ground #F4EFE6, roads #7C7C84, water #9CCBE8, buildings #8E5B3A, #4D8FD1, #F2B33D, #4FB286, trees #8CC084. No gradients, no shadows, no text, no letters. Wide landscape format, aspect ratio about 2:1.
styles.concept:
Purpose: a reference image of one building for a mobile puzzle game about building roads on a square grid. A 3D model will be built from it, so the layout must be exact and easy to read.

View: strictly top-down orthographic, the camera looks straight down. No perspective, no isometric angle, no visible side walls, no tilt.

Style: clean low-poly game art. Every surface is one solid flat color; roof parts at different heights are told apart only by slightly lighter or darker flat tones. Few large shapes that stay readable on a phone screen.

Palette: ground #F4EFE6, asphalt #7C7C84, markings #F4EFE6, greenery #8CC084, plus the building colors named below.

Constraints: no gradients, no textures, no noise, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no outlines, no people, no vehicles. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere. Do not draw the grid lines themselves.

items.subject: A short straight road segment seen from above, with a dashed center line.

A classic rubber eraser tilted 45 degrees: a rectangle with rounded corners, split across its width by a thin gap into a short end and a longer body, with two short parallel motion strokes behind it showing the erasing movement. Make it clearly recognizable as an eraser, not a plain rectangle.
An elevated highway: a road deck standing on two pillars, side view.
A vertical traffic light with three round lamps.
A roundabout seen from above: a ring road around a small round island, with four short road arms.
Pause symbol: two vertical bars with rounded ends.
Play symbol: one triangle with rounded corners pointing right.
Fast-forward symbol: two triangles with rounded corners pointing right, touching each other.
A loudspeaker with two curved sound waves on its right.
A loudspeaker with a small diagonal cross on its right instead of sound waves.
A simple calendar page with two binding rings at the top and a grid of small squares.
A small rounded car, side view.
A simple arched bridge, side view, over a flat wavy line of water.
A stack of three square road tiles seen at a slight angle, with a plus sign. Accent color #F2B33D (yellow) for the plus sign.
An arched bridge, side view, over water. Accent color #4D8FD1 (blue) for the water.
A vertical traffic light with three round lamps. Accent color #4FB286 (green) for the lowest lamp only.
A roundabout seen from above: a ring road with four short arms around a round island. Accent color #8E5B3A (brown) for the island.
An elevated highway on pillars, side view, with a small car on it. Accent color #9572C9 (purple) for the car.

The land block has a light blue top and layered brown soil sides. A road crossroads with dashed markings divides it into four blocks; small rounded cars drive on it. A tall stepped blue-grey glass tower stands at the back, a peach brick apartment block on the left with a traffic light over the road, a blue cone-shaped futuristic building on the right, a small monument with stones in the front block.

A small pastel city seen from above: houses of different colors connected by roads, a river with a bridge on the right side, a few round trees. Keep the left third of the image almost empty (plain ground color) for the game title.
